description: This file defines the LeaveBalanceAPI class, which serves as a REST API endpoint for fetching leave balance information for employees within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides methods for retrieving leave balances, breakdowns over date ranges, and related metadata, primarily for leave balancing and reporting functions.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for fetching and calculating employee leave balances and breakdowns in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve leave balance information for a specific leave type and employee, optionally over a date range or as of a specific date.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne() API method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Not implemented; raises an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update() method (not implemented).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; raises an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete() method (not implemented).

methods.name: getLeaveBreakdownForAppliedDateRange
methods.description: Generates leave breakdown data over a specified date range, grouped by leave periods, including holidays and weekends.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the leave period object based on employee, leave type, and date.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeAsArray
methods.description: Fetches and normalizes leave type data as an array for metadata output.

methods.name: getNormalizedLeaveBalanceResult
methods.description: Normalizes leave balance breakdowns, updating the balance and marking negative balances as needed.
